filed: 2026-11-22, compare-lead, before the script was first run

inputs.procedural: experiments/procedural_rl/results/score_rb.json .points (P2.56/E261: R_b = E_b, KL from the unchanged model, seven proxies per state)
inputs.pairs: experiments/rb_states/results/summary_items.json .pairs (E257: E_b and dw_rel_norm per state of the nine built pairs)
inputs.pair_kl: kl_fm_saved in experiments/rb_states/results/items/<state>.json, else kl_fm in experiments/kstar_pairs/results/items/<state>_block.json (E205, same number: e62/copy_s0 reads 3.159 in both)

expected.control_kl_given_kl: partial Spearman of KL itself with R_b given KL: undefined (no variance left), reported as null
expected.control_rb_residual: partial Spearman of a synthetic proxy equal to R_b's rank residual on KL's ranks, given KL: 1.0 within 1e-9
expected.raw_pair_gaps: equal E257's gap_E_b per pair within 1e-12 (same items, same means)
expected.random_arms: reported apart; E_b and KL both at their floor (E_b 0.009-0.013, KL ~0.001), so their Spearman is read but not pooled

rules.floor: max E_b over E257's random updates (summary_items.json .randoms), 0.0109
rules.pair_survives: a pair's residual gap (mean residual of reuse states minus mean residual of new states, E_b regressed on KL by ordinary least squares over the unique trained pair states) is outside +-floor
rules.rival_a: 0 of 9 residual gaps outside +-floor AND every proxy's partial Spearman with R_b given KL, trained procedural states, |rho| < 0.3
rules.rival_b: the pairs whose raw gap is outside +-floor keep a residual gap outside it, same sign, AND at least one proxy has partial |rho| >= 0.3
rules.otherwise: mixed: reported as read, no call
